screens.title: Volume breakout
screens.description: Price breaks above its recent range on unusually heavy volume, with most shares taken for delivery.
rules: All technical screens: companies only (no ETFs), average traded value ≥ ₹1 crore a day
Close above the highest high of the previous 20 sessions, or a new 52-week high
Volume at least 2× its 20-day average; delivery at least 50%
Close higher than the previous day; hits from the last 5 sessions are shown

screens.title: Near 52-week high
screens.description: Trading just under the 52-week high with volume picking up: candidates to break out next.
rules: Close within 5% below the highest high of the last 52 weeks (or of the history stored so far)
20-day average volume at least 1.2× the 50-day average
Close above its 50-day average

screens.title: Delivery accumulation
screens.description: Delivery share rising while the price goes nowhere: someone may be quietly building a position.
rules: 10-day average delivery at least 50%, and at least 1.2× its average of the 50 sessions before
Price range over the last 10 sessions within 10%
Volume not drying up: 10-day average at least 0.8× the 50-day average

screens.title: Pullback in uptrend
screens.description: A stock in a healthy uptrend dipping back to its 20-day average on light volume.
rules: 50-day average above the 200-day average, and close above the 50-day average
Low of the last 3 sessions within 2% of the 20-day average; close not more than 2% below it
Volume over those 3 sessions under 0.8× the 50-day average; 3-month return positive
Needs 200 sessions of history

screens.title: Tight base
screens.description: Price coiling in a narrow range near its highs while volume dries up, often before a move.
rules: Price range over the last 15 sessions within 10%
10-day average volume at most 0.6× the 50-day average
Close above the 50-day average and within 15% of the 52-week high

screens.title: Relative strength leaders
screens.description: The top 10% of liquid stocks by 3, 6 and 12-month performance, still in an uptrend.
rules: Relative strength 90 or above (1–99 rank of weighted 3, 6 and 12-month returns among liquid stocks)
Close above its 50-day average and within 25% of its 52-week high
12-month return uses the history stored so far until a full year is available

screens.title: Quality compounder
screens.description: High returns on capital, profits backed by cash, little debt, sensible price.
rules: 10-point scorecard: ROCE ≥ 15% (2), ROE ≥ 12% (1), sales growth ≥ 12%/yr (1),
profit growth ≥ 12%/yr and not lagging sales (1), cash from operations ≥ 70% of profit (2; ≥ 40%: 1),
debt-to-equity ≤ 0.5 (1), interest cover ≥ 4× (1), PEG ≤ 1.5 or P/E ≤ 40 (1)
Listed from 8 points; alert when a stock first reaches 9

screens.title: Growth
screens.description: Sales and profits compounding fast over 3 years and still growing fast in the latest year and quarter.
rules: Sales and profit growth ≥ 15% a year over the period, and ≥ 15% in the latest year
Latest quarter vs the same quarter last year: sales and profit up ≥ 15% (when 5 quarters are available)
ROE ≥ 12%; profitable in each of the last 3 years; growth off a near-zero profit base is ignored

screens.title: Value
screens.description: Profitable, decently run businesses priced cheaply on earnings and book value.
rules: P/E between 3 and 15 (latest 12 months' profit; under 3 usually means a one-off gain or bad data)
Price-to-book ≤ 2.5
ROE ≥ 12% on average; profitable in each of the last 3 years
Cash from operations ≥ 50% of profit; debt-to-equity ≤ 1

screens.title: Penny (clean)
screens.description: Low-priced or small companies that are genuinely profitable and cash-generating, minus story stocks.
rules: Market cap ≤ ₹1,000 crore, and share price ≤ ₹50 or market cap ≤ ₹500 crore; main board (EQ) only
Profitable in each of the last 3 years; positive cash from operations overall
Debt-to-equity ≤ 0.5, ROE ≥ 10%, sales growing
Excluded: any stock on the Narrative / operator screen

screens.title: Turnaround
screens.description: Companies that made losses a few years ago and are now profitable, with profit and balance sheet improving.
rules: A loss in an earlier year; profitable in each of the last 2 years with profit rising
Latest 12 months profitable
Debt flat or falling over 2 years, or debt-to-equity ≤ 0.5

screens.title: Dividend payers
screens.description: Consistent dividend payers with a decent yield that profits and cash flow comfortably cover.
rules: Dividend yield ≥ 2.5% (last year's dividends paid ÷ today's market cap)
Dividends paid in at least 3 of the years available
Payout ≤ 80% of profit; profitable in each of the last 3 years

screens.title: Corporate actions
screens.description: Upcoming dividends, splits, bonus and rights issues, shown only while there is still time to buy.
rules: Ex-date still ahead; the last day to buy is the trading day before the ex-date (T+1 settlement)
Dividend yield = dividend per share ÷ last close; alert at 3% or more
Alert only when at least 2 trading days are left to buy
Rights issues show the discount of the issue price to the market price
Trading days count weekdays only; exchange holidays are not yet excluded

screens.title: Narrative / operator
screens.description: Filings that often come with story-driven stocks: control changes, cheap equity to promoters, order headlines, exchange volume queries.
rules: Open offer / control change: 2 points
Preferential issue / warrants: 2 points
Exchange price/volume query: 2 points
Rights issue: 1 point
Order / contract / MoU: 1 point
Merger / amalgamation: 1 point
Fund-raising approval: 1 point
Split / bonus: 1 point
Each type counts once per stock over the last 365 days; listed from 2 points, alert at 5

screens.title: Bulk & block deals
screens.description: Large trades disclosed by NSE over the last 10 sessions, netted per stock.
rules: Bulk deals (≥0.5% of shares in a day) and block deals from NSE's daily files
Buys and sells netted per stock over the last 10 sessions
Listed when net value is at least ₹1 crore either way; net buyers score higher
